transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... I have this issue with elevators. I mean, I know they aren't actually dangerous. But when I have to get in one, I just get really scared. It feels like I'm going to be trapped in there, and I just can't seem to make myself feel normal about it.
When you feel afraid in an elevator, is the main fear being trapped and unable to escape, or being judged or embarrassed by the other people there?

It's definitely the trapped part. I don't really care about other people judging me or anything like that. It's just... knowing I can't open the doors and walk out whenever I want to. That's what gets me.
